item.title: Running Backstage in Dev Container
item.description:
Okay so I’ve been wanting to make the process of getting up and running with backstage simpler. The aim is to setup a full environment with containers for

  • IAM
  • Documentation Generation
  • Cloud Cost Extraction
  • Terraform Deployment / Destruction
  • Model to track resources deployed by via terraform

Other features will include:

  • Helm chart for full deployment
  • CI pipeline for deployment to kubernetes
  • Set of project templates for my own use
    • Hugo Site
    • dotnet API
    • node API
    • golang API
    • Python API
    • orgmode project starter
    • Python GenAI project, including RAG

I’m really looking to meld together the infrastructure and deployment side of things.
